description: This file is a Java implementation of the Permission data access object (DAO) for managing permission entities within the shopizer application's core business logic. It includes methods for listing permissions, retrieving permissions by ID, fetching permissions by group IDs, and querying permissions based on specific criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDaoImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the PermissionDao interface, providing database operations for permission entities.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all distinct permissions ordered by their ID in ascending order.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a permission entity based on its unique ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of permissions associated with the specified set of group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a list of permissions that match the specified criteria, including filtering by group IDs and pagination options.
